_note: A payment or deposit by an individual, as parent or guardian, to the account of a minor under the notified pension scheme: s.124(4) allows the deduction under s.124(3) for it, "subject to the condition that the aggregate amount of deduction under sub-section (3) and this sub-section shall not exceed ₹50000" (Gazette 265620, p.160). Not a Schedule XV sum. D-130. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80CCD(1B), second proviso (Gazette CG-DL-E-29032025-262125, Finance Act, 2025 s.17, p.22): "where any payment or deposit is made to the account of a minor under the pension scheme … by the assessee, being the parent or guardian of such minor", the aggregate under (1B) not exceeding fifty thousand rupees (w.e.f. 1-4-2026, AY 2026-27). sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md; D-144.
